timeKiosk.title: Kiosk management
timeKiosk.management.trowser.title: Manage your time kiosks
timeKiosk.management.trowser.description: Authorize any internet-connected computer or tablet as a kiosk to allow multiple workers to quickly clock in and out from one device.
timeKiosk.management.trowser.pinNote: Kiosk users can set up their own PIN.
timeKiosk.inactivityTimeout.modal.title: Edit inactivity timeout
timeKiosk.inactivityTimeout.modal.descri: This applies to all kiosks. After this many seconds of no activity, the kiosk returns to the home screen.
timeKiosk.settingsHandle.description: Add or remove computers or tablets your team uses to clock in and out
